steps: Buy a qualifying product (all-in-one washer + electric dryer, air purifier, standalone dehumidifier, clothes washer, or electric dryer) by December 31, 2026.
Install it at your ComEd service address and keep the itemized sales receipt.
Submit the official ComEd 2026 appliance rebate application within 60 days of purchase (or by February 28, 2027, whichever is earlier).
After approval, your rebate check arrives in approximately four weeks.
timing: Rebate check issued approximately four weeks after your application is approved.
